name: Kreativ Internal Links Audit
description: A full internal linking health audit to improve structure, crawl depth, and discoverability.
cardMeta: Audit internal linking quality across your site.
cardUse: Identify weak, missing, and unbalanced internal links to improve structure and crawlability.
metaDescription: Audit internal link quality, discover weak link patterns, and improve crawlability.

detailItems.title: Link distribution analysis
detailItems.body: Identify underlinked pages and excessive concentration around a small subset of URLs.

detailItems.title: Coverage and opportunity signals
detailItems.body: Surface link gaps where related pages should reference each other for better navigation and crawl paths.

detailItems.title: Actionable prioritization
detailItems.body: Highlight high-value fixes first so teams can improve structural quality with predictable effort.

ctaLines: Current status: In development. Submission prep and release scoping are in progress.
Follow our News page for release updates.

items.title: Content-heavy WordPress sites
items.body: This plugin is aimed at publishers, agencies, and site owners who need a clearer view of how internal links are distributed across a growing content base.

items.title: Teams doing ongoing maintenance
items.body: It is especially useful when internal linking is no longer something you can review manually page by page.

items.title: Weak structure is hard to see early
items.body: Many WordPress sites accumulate underlinked pages, uneven link concentration, and missed linking opportunities without obvious warning signs.

items.title: Manual audits do not scale
items.body: The goal is to turn crawl-structure and internal-linking issues into a practical maintenance workflow instead of an occasional one-off review.

items.title: What v1 will include
items.body: The first version is expected to focus on underlinked pages, internal-link imbalance, and actionable signals for missing or weak contextual links.

items.title: What v1 will not do
items.body: The first release is not intended to be a full SEO suite or an automatic link-rewriting tool. It is being scoped as a focused audit and reporting plugin.
